decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already requires randomly allocated no-referral commissions to appear on the dashboard and in NFT attributes, so no additional change is needed.
The source Event changes visibility of randomly allocated commissions, not ticket-generation or ticket-accounting rules.
Displaying random commissions does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source decision concerns commission visibility in the dashboard and NFT attributes, not public referral-count statistics.
Commission visibility does not change the requirement to display referral counts accurately.
Adding a commission attribute does not change NFT image, cover, or media-rendering behavior.
The commission-display decision does not alter the counting basis for public mint statistics.
The source Event does not change prize-pool amounts or their public presentation.
Random commission visibility is independent of the public sales-remaining countdown for the next prize draw.
The client requires the commission to be displayed in dashboard and NFT-attribute interfaces but does not require a corresponding FAQ-content revision.
The source Event changes presentation of randomly allocated commissions but does not change their amount, allocation condition, recipient-selection rule, or unresolved first-mint edge case.
No-referral commission visibility does not alter secondary-sale royalty amount, enforcement, allocation, or marketplace policy.
